book.name: GALETIA
book.title: ME GALETIA ꞌIDI LETA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Miya boboꞌana manuna Keliso ꞌiliꞌamida ꞌada yonao ꞌediyega, ꞌenega wada toolopaꞌala be geyaꞌabo watagwatagwala limanemi Mosese ꞌina loina yoniyonina ꞌenaya.
Keliso ꞌina loina boboꞌana
ꞌAboꞌagu Paulo yaloguguya ꞌemiya be ꞌabo Mosese ꞌina loinao ꞌediya watagwalemi, nai ꞌabo me Yudia ꞌidi weꞌiweꞌiyaya lodaba
bwalamiya sida guinuwe, Keliso ꞌina lema ꞌemiya waloseye.
Manuna ꞌeguma yaita ꞌemiyega ꞌitagwale be bwalana silodabai, ꞌilobwene be Mosese ꞌina loinao maiboꞌadi wate ꞌida ematamatanedi,
be ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo nuwanuwayo be Mosese ꞌina loinao ꞌadi ematamatana ꞌenega ꞌawaboboꞌana ꞌuda loba, niꞌatu Keliso ꞌina oboboma ꞌemuya ꞌuloseyena, ga tauna ꞌupilisinena.
Manuna ꞌaboꞌada Yaubada taemisena be ꞌaene ꞌiꞌawa palupaluyeda. Gete ꞌida nuwayaina Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌenega, ga manuna tayamwayamwa.

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yesu Keliso ꞌenaya me Yudia ꞌadi weꞌiweꞌiyaya, nate bwaladi silodaba, nigeya ꞌigiepaepaluyeda, be wate ꞌabo lodaba taguitoyase geyaꞌabo ꞌada ꞌawapalupalu talobaloba. Nate namo ꞌeguma Yesu taemise be taobobome, tauna ꞌada togiepalu.
ꞌOmi lowa wapili waiwai emisa ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌenega, ꞌenega yaita ꞌisaꞌu bodemi?
ꞌEtoboda gete nigeya Yaubada ꞌenega, manuna lowa Yaubada ꞌibwauyemi tauna ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌenaya, ta esi ꞌetoboda gete mali tomota ꞌediyega.
Getei ꞌatuwa ꞌebweu yage gidalina, ta esi toꞌumalina, ta sawesawenaya be ꞌigie toꞌumali sinabwana.
ꞌAboꞌagu ꞌInapwana yaemisena be ꞌigienuwa sabwalenimi, be ꞌigu loina namo wada muliye, ta ꞌabo yaita tauna ꞌami togieloniu, ꞌana eꞌisa Yaubada ꞌenega maꞌetamo ꞌiloba.

Gosegwao, geyaꞌabo wanuwena ꞌaboꞌagu yaloguloguguya be ꞌaene tomota sida lodabadi be me Yudia ꞌidi loina sida muliyedi, ta ꞌigu loguguya esi Keliso ꞌina mwawasa kelose ꞌenaya manuna, ta loguguya gete manuna me Yudia sinuwamwau ga sietalauwalegu.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌilobwenena be taudi ꞌami togieloniu nidi taudimo siloꞌewa yauledi be ꞌewaꞌewadi.

Gosegwao, Yaubada niꞌatu ꞌiesinuwemi ga liꞌaliꞌamimi, ta geyaꞌabo wanuwena ꞌaene nigeya ꞌami loinamo be bubuna baleꞌu wamulimuliyedi, ta esi oboboma ꞌina loinega wada tauya be taumimo wada elemalema limanemi.
Manuna loina maiboꞌadi ꞌadi bwagila, loina ꞌebweuna gete, ꞌigwae, “Gosemwao ꞌuda obobomedi nadigega tauyo ꞌamu oboboma.”
ꞌEguma loina gete wapilisine be taumimo ꞌemiya waetalauwala, maꞌetamo ꞌami boda waloesawali.
Yaluyaluwa uwana dumadumana ta bwala uwana dumadumana
ꞌEnega ꞌilobwenemi be Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌianuganemi ta ꞌenega geyaꞌabo yalakwaiyao siloiloinemi.

Manuna yalakwaiyao Yaluyaluwa Tabuna sietalauwalena, ta saꞌi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌida yalakwaiyao ꞌietalauwaledi. ꞌEnega soladaya silosalosaiya, ta toꞌase boboꞌana nuwanuwada be taguinuwei nigeya sawesawedaya be taguinuwei.
Nate namo ꞌeguma Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌianuganemi, Mosese ꞌina loinao sigugumwala ꞌemiyega.
Ooda ꞌina guinuwao tamwalamwalatonidi, nate loelata, loyawe, gagasa,
nabwasuwa, balau, egewagewana, etalauwala, eꞌipiꞌipi, gamwasowala, debaose, weyala, sinala, eꞌidiꞌidi,

be wate ꞌebe gwausowala toꞌumalina bwasi waiwai ꞌana numa ꞌenega, ta ꞌaina wate bubuna toꞌumalidi. Bubuna getedi manudi lowa yaemataluwemi, ta batuwa yaemataluwa limami ꞌaene ꞌadi toguinuwao geyaꞌabo Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌena silugulugu.
Ta saꞌi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna uwana boboꞌadi ꞌatedaya getedi, oboboma, gwausowala, miyasiwalowa, toolopaꞌala, lema, bubuna palupaluna, emisa,
bubuna nuwana, ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita. Ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate loina ꞌimiyami be yage getedi ꞌida ꞌetobodedi.
Ta wate ꞌeguma Yesu Keliso ꞌiloineda, ooda ꞌina bubuna toꞌumalidi be yalakwaiyao ꞌiloemwawasidi ꞌana kelose ꞌenaya.
Ta yawasida boboꞌana ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeda Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌenega, ta ꞌilobwenena be Yaluyaluwa nina ꞌianuganeda.
Ta geyaꞌabo tanuwanuwa tuꞌe, nai gosedao taeꞌoataꞌoatadi, nai taeꞌipiꞌipiyedi.

footnotes.text: daba nai lodaba: Nugana 17:10-14 ꞌena Yaubada Ebelaamo ꞌiloinena be ꞌaene tauna be natunao meꞌolotodi be tubunao meꞌolotodi ꞌidi yage bwaladi sida ꞌupwa yauledi, nate weꞌiweꞌiyaya nai ꞌebe ꞌinana sida guinuwe, ta ꞌana mwalatoi taudi Yaubada ꞌina tomotaiyao esiesinuwadi.
